uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-8227-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6972-8227-8329--225.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
6972-8227-8329--225.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.
6972-8227-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

4009-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4009-5660-6769-6797.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mox Opal, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

4490-7436--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-7436--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Pest Mascot triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-7436--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2506-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2506-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1060-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Sun-Crowned Hunters to take damage.
1060-5166--86.description:
Cause Sun-Crowned Hunters to take damage by any method.
Sun-Crowned Hunters triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4365-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3490-5231-6822-7920.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-5231-6822-7920.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

489-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Nylea.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
489-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4396-4659-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4396-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2957-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
2957-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-3000-3921-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Squirrel and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-3197-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-4268.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1418-1645-5954-6763.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2743-5134-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2743-5134-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-5134-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Fated Infatuation at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Fated Infatuation spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

292-3129-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3129-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

647-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1495-2474-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
1495-2474-4120.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

397-5104-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature token.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5104-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

969-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

5149-5200-5983.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
5149-5200-5983.notablePrerequisites:
Snapping Voidcraw does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Snapping Voidcraw
5149-5200-5983.description:
Activate Snapping Voidcraw by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Snapping Voidcraw.
Repeat.
5149-5200-5983.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them, or you can use it to draw cards using Snapping Voidcraw.

requires.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it
with a takeover counter on it

2511-5326--5--6.notablePrerequisites:
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of either the persist or undying creature.
The Master does not have a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a copy of the undying creature, or a -1/-1 counter on it otherwise.
2511-5326--5--6.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, if it was a copy of the undying creature, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if The Master was a copy of the persist creature, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of the undying creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

940-2178-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
940-2178-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1124-1636-2034-3650-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Elspeth's Talent attached to another planeswalker you control.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-2034-3650-4091.description:
Activate the planeswalker with Elspeth's Talent attached by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

3169-4559-4659-4871.notablePrerequisites: You conrol noncreature artifacts with a total mana value of 10 or greater.
3169-4559-4659-4871.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Treasure and Myr, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

152-1308-1872.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate both Composite Golem tokens by sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

224-2232-2248.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
224-2232-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

1102-2178-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Steel Overseer.
Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-2178-3490-4050.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
The Servo dies, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping Steel Overseer.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Animation Module trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1029-1283-1358.description:
Activate Sydri for {1} of any color due to Chromatic Orrery, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature.
Activate Chromatic Orrery for {5}, drawing at least 3 cards (more if you control permanents with the colors you're missing).
Tolarian Kraken triggers 3 times, targeting Chromatic Orrery with all 3 triggers.
Pay for the first trigger with {1}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
In response to the second trigger, tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Spend {1} for the seonc trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery again.
In response to the third trigger, tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Pay {1} for the last Tolarian Kraken ability, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2 for infinite card draw and Near-infinite mana.
